scenario: Identifier shape per LGRA.15.2 — bindings/slots are lowercase-start (IDENT), types are uppercase-start (TYPE_NAME); the parser distinguishes by case. A schema with a Title-cased name + lowercased slots + a rule with a lowercased binding compiles cleanly. (The `__X__` shape is not reserved, [LLEX.10.6.1]; compiler/LLEX.10.6.1_author_double_underscore_name_compiles pins it.)
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig my_binding
->
    log info "{my_binding.v}"
